Keeping the rules in one place prevents\n# the duplication that existed between EncountersController and DmController,\n# and guarantees that the deterministic evaluator sees identical results.\nmodule DndRules\n  extend ActiveSupport::Concern\n\n  # Identifier pattern used for campaigns, characters, quests, sessions, and\n  # compendium slugs. Keep this in sync with the cumulative evaluator fixtures.\n  VALID_ID_RE = /\\A[a-z0-9_-]+\\z/.freeze\n\n  # 5e encounter XP budgets by challenge rating.\n  XP_BY_CR = {\n    '0' => 10,\n    '1/8' => 25,\n    '1/4' => 50,\n    '1/2' => 100,\n    '1' => 200,\n    '2' => 450,\n    '3' => 700,\n    '4' => 1100,\n    '5' => 1800\n  }.freeze\n\n  # Per-character daily encounter thresholds by level. Only level 3 is needed by\n  # the current evaluator, but the structure mirrors the full 5e table.\n  LEVEL_THRESHOLDS = {\n    3 => { easy: 75, medium: 150, hard: 225, deadly: 400 }\n  }.freeze\n\n  # 5e ability modifier for a score in the 1..30 range. Shared between\n  # CharactersController and PlayCampaignsController so the math stays\n  # identical across the codebase. Named `modifier_for` to avoid shadowing\n  # the `ability_modifier` action in CharactersController.\n  def modifier_for(score)\n    (score - 10) / 2\n  end\n\n  # 5e proficiency bonus by character level (1..20). Kept in one place so\n  # both the character utilities and the play surface use the same curve.\n  def proficiency_bonus(level)\n    case level\n    when 1..4 then 2\n    when 5..8 then 3\n    when 9..12 then 4\n    when 13..16 then 5\n    else 6\n    end\n  end\n\n  # True when +value+ is a non-empty string matching the shared ID pattern.\n  def valid_id?(value)\n    value.is_a?(String) && VALID_ID_RE.match?(value)\n  end\n\n  # True when +value+ is a non-empty string.\n  def valid_non_empty_string?(value)\n    value.is_a?(String) && !value.empty?\n  end\n\n  # Look up a campaign by id. Renders 404 and returns nil when missing.\n  #\n  # Callers must validate the id format first if they want a 400 for invalid\n  # ids; this helper does not validate and simply treats malformed ids as not\n  # found.\n  def find_campaign(id)\n    row = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n      'SELECT id, name, dm FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n      id\n    )\n    if row.nil?\n      render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n      return nil\n    end\n    row\n  end\n\n  # Sort combatants by initiative score, then dexterity, then name (descending).\n  # Returns an array of { 'name' => ..., 'score' => ... } hashes. The caller is\n  # expected to have already validated the combatant shape.\n  def initiative_order(combatants)\n    entries = combatants.map do |c|\n      {\n        'name' => c['name'],\n        'dex' => c['dex'],\n        'score' => c['roll'] + c['dex']\n      }\n    end\n\n    entries.sort! do |a, b|\n      [b['score'], b['dex'], a['name']] <=> [a['score'], a['dex'], b['name']]\n    end\n\n    entries.map { |e| { 'name' => e['name'], 'score' => e['score'] } }\n  end\n\n  # Validate a party array and return the summed daily encounter thresholds.\n  # Renders a 400 and returns nil for invalid or unsupported party members.\n  def build_party_thresholds(party)\n    thresholds = { easy: 0, medium: 0, hard: 0, deadly: 0 }\n    party.each do |member|\n      unless member.is_a?(Hash) && member['level'].is_a?(Integer)\n        bad_request('invalid party member')\n        return nil\n      end\n      th = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[member['level']]\n      unless th\n        bad_request('unsupported level')\n        return nil\n      end\n      thresholds.each_key { |k| thresholds[k] += th[k] }\n    end\n    thresholds\n  end\n\n  # Validate a monster list of { 'cr' => ..., 'count' => ... } hashes and return\n  # [base_xp, monster_count]. Renders a 400 and returns nil for invalid input.\n  def sum_monster_xp(monsters)\n    base_xp = 0\n    monster_count = 0\n    monsters.each do |monster|\n      unless monster.is_a?(Hash) && monster['cr'].is_a?(String) && monster['count'].is_a?(Integer)\n        bad_request('invalid monster')\n        return nil\n      end\n      xp = XP_BY_CR[monster['cr']]\n      unless xp\n        bad_request('unsupported challenge rating')\n        return nil\n      end\n      base_xp += xp * monster['count']\n      monster_count += monster['count']\n    end\n    [base_xp, monster_count]\n  end\n\n  # Return [numerator, denominator] for the 5e encounter size multiplier.\n  def encounter_multiplier(monster_count)\n    case monster_count\n    when 1 then [1, 1]\n    when 2 then [3, 2]\n    when 3..6 then [2, 1]\n    when 7..10 then [5, 2]\n    when 11..14 then [3, 1]\n    else [4, 1]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Map an adjusted XP total against the supplied thresholds to a difficulty\n  # label. The evaluator expects these exact strings.\n  def difficulty_label(adjusted_xp, thresholds)\n    if adjusted_xp >= thresholds[:deadly]\n      'deadly'\n    elsif adjusted_xp >= thresholds[:hard]\n      'hard'\n    elsif adjusted_xp >= thresholds[:medium]\n      'medium'\n    elsif adjusted_xp >= thresholds[:easy]\n      'easy'\n    else\n      'trivial'\n    end\n  end\nend\n"}]},"isError":false}

valid_non_empty_string?(target)\n      bad_request('invalid target')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless valid_non_empty_string?(condition)\n      bad_request('invalid condition')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless duration_rounds.is_a?(Integer) && duration_rounds > 0\n      bad_request('invalid duration_rounds')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      unless combatant_exists?(combatants, target)\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      conditions = JSON.parse(encounter[6] || '{}')\n      conditions[target] ||= []\n      conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => duration_rounds }\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET conditions_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [JSON.generate(conditions), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        target: target,\n        conditions: conditions[target].map { |c| { condition: c['condition'], remaining_rounds: c['remaining_rounds'] } }\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def encounter_status\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    enc_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign_member?(campaign_id, username, campaign[1])\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      round, turn_index, active = current_encounter_state(encounter)\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n      conditions = JSON.parse(encounter[6] || '{}')\n\n      existing_keys = ordered.map { |c| combatant_key(c) }.to_set\n      conditions_map = {}\n      conditions.each do |key, list|\n        next unless existing_keys.include?(key)\n        conditions_map[key] = list.map { |cond| { condition: cond['condition'], remaining_rounds: cond['remaining_rounds'] } }\n      end\n\n      render json: {\n        round: round,\n        turn_index: turn_index,\n        active: active ? serialize_active_combatant(active) : nil,\n        order: ordered.map { |c| serialize_active_combatant(c) },\n        conditions: conditions_map\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def rewards\n    xp = @body['xp']\n    loot = @body['loot']\n\n    unless xp.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid xp')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless loot.is_a?(Array)\n      bad_request('invalid loot')\n      return\n    end\n\n    loot.each do |item|\n      unless item.is_a?(Hash) && valid_id?(item['slug']) && item['quantity'].is_a?(Integer) && item['quantity'] > 0\n        bad_request('invalid loot')\n        return\n      end\n    end\n\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    unless valid_id?(encounter_id)\n      bad_request('invalid encounter id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      if !encounter[8].nil? || (encounter[9] && encounter[9] != '[]')\n        render json: { error: 'rewards already awarded' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET xp_awarded = ?, loot_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [xp, JSON.generate(loot), campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        id: encounter_id,\n        xp: xp,\n        loot: loot\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def close_encounter\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    unless valid_id?(encounter_id)\n      bad_request('invalid encounter id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        ['closed', campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n\n      xp_awarded = encounter[8] || 0\n\n      render json: {\n        id: encounter_id,\n        status: 'closed',\n        xp_awarded: xp_awarded\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def end_encounter\n    encounter_id = params[:enc_id]\n    unless valid_id?(encounter_id)\n      bad_request('invalid encounter id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      campaign_state = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT phase, saved_actor, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n      phase = campaign_state[0] || 'exploration'\n\n      if phase != 'combat'\n        render json: { error: 'campaign is not in combat' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      if encounter[2] == 'active'\n        GameStorage.db.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          ['closed', campaign_id, encounter_id]\n        )\n      end\n\n      restored_actor = campaign_state[1] || campaign_state[2]\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET phase = ?, current_actor = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      hp_current = member[1] || 20\n      hp_max = member[2] || 20\n      status = member[3] || 'conscious'\n      successes = member[4] || 0\n      failures = member[5] || 0\n\n      new_hp = [hp_current - amount, 0].max\n      new_status = status\n      new_successes = successes\n      new_failures = failures\n\n      if new_hp == 0 && status != 'dead'\n        new_status = 'unconscious'\n        new_successes = 0\n        new_failures = 0\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [new_hp, new_status, new_successes, new_failures, campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: { target: char_id, hp_before: hp_current, hp_after: new_hp, damage: amount }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def death_saves\n    outcome = @body['outcome']\n\n    unless outcome.is_a?(String) && %w[success failure].include?(outcome)\n      bad_request('invalid outcome')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless member[0] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      status = member[1] || 'conscious'\n      successes = member[2] || 0\n      failures = member[3] || 0\n\n      unless status == 'unconscious'\n        render json: { error: 'character is not unconscious' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      new_successes = successes\n      new_failures = failures\n      new_status = status\n\n      if outcome == 'success'\n        new_successes = [successes + 1, 3].min\n        new_status = 'stable' if new_successes >= 3\n      else\n        new_failures = [failures + 1, 3].min\n        new_status = 'dead' if new_failures >= 3\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless member[2] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      new_owner_member = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, new_owner]\n      )\n\n      unless new_owner_member\n        render json: { error: 'new owner is not a member' }, status: :bad_request\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET owner = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET race = ?, class = ?, background = ?, hp_max = ?, hp_current = ?, abilities_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [race, class_name, background, hp_max, hp_max, JSON.generate(abilities), campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        race: race,\n        class: class_name,\n        background: background,\n        level: level,\n        hp_max: hp_max,\n        proficiency_bonus: proficiency_bonus\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def level_up\n    level = @body['level']\n\n    unless level.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid level')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, level, hp_max, class, abilities_json FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      current_level = member[3] || 1\n      unless level == current_level + 1 && level <= 20\n        bad_request('invalid level')\n        return\n      end\n\n      class_name = member[5]\n      hit_die = HIT_DICE[class_name]\n      unless hit_die\n        bad_request('invalid class')\n        return\n      end\n\n      abilities = JSON.parse(member[6] || '{}')\n      con_score = abilities['con']\n      unless con_score.is_a?(Integer) && con_score >= 1 && con_score <= 30\n        bad_request('missing abilities')\n        return\n      end\n\n      con_mod = modifier_for(con_score)\n      hp_increase = average_die(hit_die) + con_mod\n      new_hp_max = (member[4] || 0) + hp_increase\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET level = ?, hp_max = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [level, new_hp_max, campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        level: level,\n        hp_max: new_hp_max,\n        hit_dice: \"1d#{hit_die}\",\n        proficiency_bonus: proficiency_bonus(level)\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def skill_check\n    skill = @body['skill']\n    ability = @body['ability']\n    proficient = @body['proficient']\n    roll = @body['roll']\n\n    unless VALID_SKILLS.include?(skill)\n      bad_request('invalid skill')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless ABILITY_NAMES.include?(ability)\n      bad_request('invalid ability')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless proficient == true || proficient == false\n      bad_request('invalid proficient')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless roll.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid roll')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, level, abilities_json FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      abilities = JSON.parse(member[4] || '{}')\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n        bad_request('invalid ability score')\n        return\n      end\n\n      level = member[3] || 1\n      modifier = modifier_for(score) + (proficient ? proficiency_bonus(level) : 0)\n      total = roll + modifier\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        skill: skill,\n        ability: ability,\n        modifier: modifier,\n        total: total\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def add_spell\n    spell_id = @body['spell_id']\n    name = @body['name']\n    level = @body['level']\n\n    unless valid_id?(spell_id)\n      bad_request('invalid spell_id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless valid_non_empty_string?(name)\n      bad_request('invalid name')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless level.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid level')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, class FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless member[2] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless spell_valid_for_class?(spell_id, member[3])\n        render json: { error: 'invalid class/spell combination' }, status: :bad_request\n        return\n      end\n\n      begin\n        GameStorage.db.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO play_campaign_spells (campaign_id, character_id, spell_id, name, level) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, char_id, spell_id, name, level]\n        )\n        render json: { spell_id: spell_id, name: name, level: level }, status: :created\n      rescue SQLite3::ConstraintException\n        render json: { error: 'duplicate spell' }, status: :conflict\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def list_spells\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      is_owner = campaign[1] == username\n      is_member = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, username]\n      )\n\n      unless is_owner || is_member\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT character_id FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      spells = GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'SELECT spell_id, name, level FROM play_campaign_spells WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? ORDER BY level, spell_id',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        { spell_id: row[0], name: row[1], level: row[2] }\n      end\n\n      render json: { spells: spells }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  private\n\n  # Return all party usernames in insertion order. The queue is built from this\n  # order, so every call site must use the same `ORDER BY ROWID` clause.\n  def party_usernames(campaign_id)\n    GameStorage.db.execute(\n      'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?
